The Tray child maps gestures to the existing TrayPort; StatusNotifier remains the adapter and AssetPort prepares images outside views.
At most four token-sized bar controls fill spare space without moving other bar groups. Overflow remains available.
One active native wheel call, one latest pending target, and at most 64 unsent steps per axis; retirement and failure clear unsubmitted work.

limits: Third-party application compatibility, watcher restarts under broader faults and legacy XEmbed remain open.
Native methods retain neutral screen-position hints; app-owned popups may not appear next to the clicked icon.
An open launcher can consume the first pointer click on the bar to dismiss its full-screen backdrop. Gesture acceptance starts with overlays closed.
The bar is non-focusable; the native test verifies keyboard activation through the overflow panel.
Horizontal/high-resolution wheel behavior is unit-tested; this VM acceptance exercises vertical wheel input.
Ordering/pinning, additional menu metadata and animated application icons remain open.
No new CPU/RSS/frame-pacing or physical-GPU performance claim; broader shell completion remains in the requirement ledger.
